title: WebView Completed pending proof flat alias cleanup
summary: Removed five Completed pending-proof helper compatibility flat exports while preserving the same helpers on window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.
reason: Continue the namespace-first WebView cleanup without touching backend mutation, media policy, publish/drain, source files, or operator command authority.
behavior_before: completedView.js exported completedPendingProofStatus, completedPendingProofSummaryLines, completedPendingProofDataStatus, completedPendingProofNextAction, and completedPendingProofRowKey both through the mediaPipelineCompletedView namespace and as transitional window.completedPendingProof* flat aliases.
behavior_after: Those five helpers remain available through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView only; the served Completed asset no longer contains the corresponding window.completedPendingProof* flat assignments. The active WebView flat-export total is 585.
tests_added: Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke.py to require the five helpers on mediaPipelineCompletedView and reject their served flat assignments.
manual_validation: Baseline before edit: npm run webview:contract:check

rg -n "window\.completedPendingProof(Status|SummaryLines|DataStatus|NextAction|RowKey)\s*=" apps\desktop\webview\static tests Docs returned no matches.
rollback_plan: Restore the five completedView.js flat assignments, rerun npm run webview:contract, restore the WebView flat-export counts to 590/94, refresh summaries, and rerun the same WebView static/browser checks.
